label: PF Backlog 228
title: Backend: output guardrails/moderation + model/data cards + provenance (C2PA) + governance mapping
body:
## Problem / why
AI products need output-level safety + governance, not just policy documents: moderation/guardrails on LLM
and media output, and provenance/model-data cards for what ships (C2PA, EU AI Act / NIST AI RMF alignment).

## Goal & value
Output-level guardrails and governance artifacts wired into the pipeline, so generated content is safe and
its provenance/licensing is provable.

## In scope
- **Guardrails/moderation:** pre/post checks on LLM + media outputs (toxicity, PII, NSFW, prompt-injection);
  configurable policy; block/flag/redact; wire into agent output path + media QA.
- **Model cards + data cards:** auto-emit per model/dataset used (license, intended use, limits).
- **Provenance:** C2PA / Content Credentials tagging for generated media; carry through packaging.
- **Governance mapping:** record NIST AI RMF / EU AI Act checkpoints; feed compliance + BOM (BI-0217).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- A disallowed generation is blocked/flagged before it reaches an artifact; policy is configurable.
- An emitted product carries model cards + (for media) C2PA provenance; packaging includes them.
- Governance checkpoints appear in the compliance/BOM output.

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: guardrail rules (allow/flag/block/redact); model-card emission; provenance tag presence.
- Integration: a blocked output never lands; a clean product carries cards + provenance.

## Links
BI-0211 (tool licence catalog), BI-0217 (BOM), BI-0218 (AI-era ops), BI-0191 (media QA), BI-0176 (guardian/legal).
